	zin_elves_send_healers = {
		icon = zin_elves_send_healers
		allowed = {
			zin_elves_is_elven_country = yes
		}
		target_root_trigger = {
			zin_elves_wanderers_room = yes
		}
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				NOT = { original_tag = ROOT }
				NOT = { has_government = communism }
				NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
				has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -1 }
			}
		}
		visible = {
			always = yes
		}
		available = {
			zin_elves_wanderers_room = yes
			FROM = {
				NOT = { has_idea = zin_elves_wanderers_lore }
				NOT = { has_idea = zin_elves_wanderers_lore_gala }
			}
		}
		cost = zin_elves_cost_healers
		days_re_enable = 365
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_elves_mission_a } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = zin_elves_mission_a days = 365 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_elves_mission_b } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = zin_elves_mission_b days = 365 }
			}
			else = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = zin_elves_mission_c days = 365 }
			}
			zin_elves_count_wanderers = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					original_tag = GAA
					has_country_flag = zin_gala_healers
				}
				FROM = {
					add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_elves_wanderers_lore_gala days = 365 }
					country_event = { id = zin_elves.55 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				FROM = {
					add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_elves_wanderers_lore days = 365 }
					country_event = { id = zin_elves.55 }
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				add = 20
				FROM = { has_government = democratic }
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_war = yes
			}
		}
